description: This file defines the 'SeoRegex' model class within the Opencart Admin module, providing methods to manage SEO regex entries in the database, including CRUD operations and retrieval of records.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Represents the SEO Regex model class for managing SEO regex records in the database within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addSeoRegex
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO regex record into the database using provided data.

methods.name: editSeoRegex
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO regex record identified by seo_regex_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteSeoRegex
methods.description: Deletes the SEO regex record identified by seo_regex_id from the database.

methods.name: getSeoRegex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SEO regex record by its seo_regex_id.

methods.name: getSeoRegexes
methods.description: Fetches a list of SEO regex records with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSeoRegexes
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO regex records in the database.
